channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Opinion | Legal reform works. The proof is right next door
item.description: Florida's 2023 legal reform package sparked significant insurance premium reductions while Alabama's market faced rising litigation-driven claims and surging costs.

item.title: Opinion | Alabama’s moment: why carbon capture, storage can make our state a national energy leader
item.description: The choice before Alabama is clear. We can lead, or we can watch others claim the benefits.

item.title: Sen. Britt pushes for expanded women’s heart health screenings
item.description: Senators Katie Britt and Angela Alsobrooks introduced bipartisan legislation Monday to expand free cardiovascular screenings for low-income and underinsured women.

item.title: Sen. Britt celebrates new U.S. District Judge for the Northern District of Alabama
item.description: Senator Katie Britt attended the investiture of Harold D. Mooty III, who secured the most bipartisan support of any 119th Congress nominee.

item.title: SCOTUS refuses to hear case which struck down anti-panhandling laws
item.description: The high court rejected Alabama's request to overturn prior verdicts, ruling that Alabama's anti-begging laws are unconstitutional.

item.title: Boyd urges clemency for Sonny Burton prior to his execution
item.description: Gubernatorial candidate Will Boyd called for clemency for Sonny Burton, arguing Alabama’s felony murder law produced an unjust death sentence.

item.title: Austal, Poarch Creeks sign agreement, will expand Alabama shipbuilding capacity
item.description: A partnership between PCI and Austal will expand the company's shipbuilding capacity in the region.

item.title: Financial records indicate Allen campaign funded Wahl ballot challenge
item.description: Campaign filings reveal $20,000 payment to attorney who drafted challenge against former ALGOP Chairman and lieutenant governor candidate John Wahl.

item.title: Governor appoints Rex Vaughn to chair Madison County Commission
item.description: A native of Madison County and longtime farm operator, Vaughn succeeded retiring Chairman Mac McCutcheon following his appointment by Governor Kay Ivey.

item.title: Gov. Ivey awards grant for program to help prison inmates end drug addictions
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey provided $598,000 for intensive drug treatment programs at eight Alabama prisons to help inmates overcome addiction and reduce future crimes.
